title: Unified-MAS: Universally Generating Domain-Specific Nodes for Empowering Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2603.21475v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex reasoning tasks. However, existing frameworks are fundamentally bottlenecked when applied to knowledge-intensive domains (e.g., healthcare and law). They either rely on a static library of general nodes like Chain-of-Thought, which lack specialized expertise, or attempt to generate nodes on the fly. In the latter case, the orchestrator is not only bound by its internal knowledge limits but must also simultaneously generate domain-specific logic and optimize high-level topology, leading to a severe architectural coupling that degrades overall system efficacy. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified-MAS that decouples granular node implementation from topological orchestration via offline node synthesis. translated_title: Unified-MAS：通用生成领域专用节点以赋能自动多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 自动多智能体系统（MAS）生成已成为解决复杂推理任务的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有框架在应用于知识密集型领域（如医疗健康和法律）时存在根本性瓶颈。它们要么依赖静态的通用节点库（如思维链），缺乏专业化专业知识；要么尝试即时生成节点。在后一种情况下，编排器不仅受限于其内部知识边界，还必须同时生成领域专用逻辑并优化高层拓扑结构，导致严重的架构耦合，从而降低整体系统效能。为弥合这一差距，我们提出Unified-MAS，通过离线节点合成将细粒度节点实现与拓扑编排解耦。Unified-MAS分两个阶段运行：（1）基于搜索的节点生成检索外部开放世界知识以合成专用……
tldr: Unified-MAS通过离线节点合成将细粒度领域专用节点实现与多智能体系统的拓扑编排解耦，从而在医疗、法律等知识密集型领域中有效提升自动多智能体系统的整体效能。
en_tdlr: Unified-MAS decouples granular domain-specific node implementation from topological orchestration via offline node synthesis, effectively empowering automatic multi-agent systems in knowledge-intensive domains such as healthcare and law.
